decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is relatively distant from this firm's established maritime and transport-support knowledge base, and with no visible performance evidence beyond continued listing, management would be likely to redeploy resources to areas where it can learn and improve faster.

Superyacht crew recruitment is a niche extension of maritime crewing capabilities, so the firm can build on related knowledge even if the market is specialised and still shows only limited public evidence of traction.

The maritime education programme fits closely with the firm's sector knowledge and external partner network, and the rapid build-up to six institutional partners suggests strong absorptive capacity and promising early adoption.

Emissions monitoring and compliance services are highly related to the firm's ship-management and regulatory capabilities, and the reported successful submission of all required plans indicates immediate commercial usefulness and strong learning effects.

The emissions compliance dashboard is integrated into the firm's existing PAL software, which makes it complementary to established capabilities and likely easier to refine through customer feedback and internal expertise.

The emissions compliance cost simulation tool also leverages the firm's existing maritime compliance knowledge and software base, though as a newer analytical product with no disclosed results it carries slightly more uncertainty than the core compliance service.
